# SYNTHETIC adapter mapping: CDU-1 vendor points -> synthetic target contract v0.1.
# Integrator's draft for the R3 liquid row. Contains a constructed demo fault; not an incident at any operator.
contract: synthetic-target-contract@0.1
site: h1
device:
  id: CDU-1
  firmware: 2.3.0
  vendor_points: cdu_vendor_points@2.3.0.csv
telemetry:
  state: run_state
  secondary.supply_temp_c: sec_supply_temp
  secondary.return_temp_c: sec_return_temp
  secondary.flow_lpm: sec_flow
  primary.supply_temp_c: fw_supply_temp
  primary.return_temp_c: fw_return_temp
state_map:  # vendor label -> contract state (quoted: YAML would read a bare off as false)
  "off": "off"
  "running": "running"
  "standby": "standby"
  "fault": "fault"
availability:
  backup_when: [standby]
leak_zones:
  - point: leak_zone_1
    location: CDU-1
  - point: leak_zone_2
    location: R3-01
  - point: leak_zone_3
    location: R3-02
valves:
  R3-01: V-R3-01
  R3-02: V-R3-02
leak_response:
  notify: Facilities
  close_rack_valve: true
freshness:
  max_age_s: 30
  recovery_samples: 2
control:
  setpoint_point: supply_setpoint
  approved_range_c: [30, 35]
  heartbeat_timeout_s: 60
  fallback_setpoint_c: 32
